description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
description.en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value for this parameter from your client. The token can be up to 64 characters in length and can contain only ASCII characters.

description.zh:
是否对此次创建请求执行预检，包括权限、实例状态校验等。可能的值：

- true：发送请求，不创建服务实例。

- false：发送请求，检查通过后创建服务实例。
description.en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. A dry run checks for permissions and instance status. Valid values:

- true: The system checks the request but does not create the service instance.

- false: The system sends the request. If the request passes the check, the service instance is created.

description.zh:
服务实例的释放时间。

> 仅支持托管版场景中，服务商对自己的服务实例设置该参数。
description.en:
The time when the service instance is released.

> Only service providers can set this parameter for their own service instances in managed scenarios.

description.zh:
服务实例名称。格式要求如下：

- 长度不超过64个字符。

- 必须以数字或英文字母开头，可包含数字、英文字母、短划线（-）和下划线（_）。
description.en:
The name of the service instance. The name must meet the following requirements:

- It can be up to 64 characters in length.

- It must start with a letter or a digit and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_).

description.zh:
服务实例部署的参数。

> 若服务实例包含部署地域信息，则需在部署参数中填写。
description.en:
The parameters used to deploy the service instance.

> If the service instance includes information about the deployment region, specify that information in the deployment parameters.

description.zh:
地域ID。可能的值：

- cn-hangzhou：华东1（杭州） 。

- ap-southeast-1：新加坡。
description.en:
The ID of the region. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: China (Hangzhou)

- ap-southeast-1: Singapore
The ID of the resource group.
The name of the specification package.

description.zh: 模板名称，服务支持多模板时需要指定模板名称。
description.en: The name of the template. Specify this parameter if the service supports multiple templates.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenestsupplier create-service-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --name TestName --service-id service-0e6fca6a51a544200000 --service-version 1 --parameters RegionId_:_cn-hangzhou_NodeCount_:_3,_SystemDiskSize_:_40,_InstancePassword_:_000000 --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --template-name Template_1 --resource-group-id rg-aekzuqyxxxxxx --user-id 1563457855xxxxxx --tag Value=value1 Key=key1 --specification-name Package_1 --dry-run false --end-time 2023-12-12T03:13:05Z --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun computenestsupplier CreateServiceInstance --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key key1 --Parameters 'RegionId_:_cn-hangzhou_NodeCount_:_3,_SystemDiskSize_:_40,_InstancePassword_:_000000' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-aekzuqyxxxxxx' --EndTime '2023-12-12T03:13:05Z' --DryRun false --Name TestName --ServiceId 'service-0e6fca6a51a544200000' --UserId 1563457855xxxxxx --Tag.1.Value value1 --ServiceVersion 1 --TemplateName Template_1 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --SpecificationName Package_1 --ClientToken '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000'
